purpose: named-checkpoint Jetson deployment measurement protocol for future/returned device evidence

primary_candidate.selection_reason: lowest parameter count among benchmark configurations not separated meaningfully by held-out accuracy

integrity_gates: same TensorRT engine SHA-256 across run set
same checkpoint SHA-256 across run set
no silent overwrite of completed run numbers
reject missing telemetry unless explicitly waived and reported

aggregation.across_run_statistics: computed over per-run means, not pooled frames
aggregation.live_stream_scope: capture + decode + inference end-to-end supplementary path

historical_boundary: This protocol measures a named checkpoint today; it does not reconstruct the non-retained historical flight engine.
